mapper.select: select l.id, l.operator_id, l.operator_type, l.action, l.from_status, l.to_status, l.remark, l.create_time, case l.operator_type when 1 then (select name from sys_staff where id = l.operator_id) when 2 then (select name from sys_resident where id = l.operator_id) else '系统' end as operator_name from wo_log l where l.order_id = #{orderId} order by l.id
